featured.title: Fault diagnosis for UAVs with hardware-in-the-loop
featured.imageAlt: QGroundControl mission plan next to a Simulink 3D view of a quadcopter flying over a city
featured.description: A MATLAB toolbox that injects sensor and actuator faults into a simulated drone, and machine learning models that detect them. The diagnostic modules were validated in simulation and then on a real Pixhawk flight controller running PX4, with the vehicle dynamics simulated in Simulink.
points: Fault injection toolbox reusable across UAV types
Feature extraction and classifier training in MATLAB
Deployed and benchmarked on the flight controller in HITL

featured.title: Super-resolution for small-object detection on edge devices
featured.imageAlt: Surveillance camera frames with detected handguns and knives marked by red boxes
featured.description: Small objects carry too few pixels for a detector to work with. This project adds a GAN-based super-resolution stage to YOLOv5 that doubles the size of backbone feature maps, targeting handgun and knife detection in surveillance footage on Jetson-class hardware.
points: DCGAN integrated between YOLOv5 backbone and neck
mAP50 of 0.739 at 416×416 with 1.5 ms inference

featured.title: GeoPosBall: underwater geospatial data logger
featured.imageAlt: The GeoPosBall buoys in open water next to a diver and a support boat during a field test
featured.description: A waterproof device that records position and orientation of objects underwater. It combines a GPS and inertial module with an M5Stamp S3 microcontroller, logs to SD card and streams over Wi-Fi. Tested in pools and open water, and brought to TRL 5 for the client.
points: IP68 enclosure with GPS and IMU fusion

featured.title: Volleyball player and ball detection
featured.imageAlt: A volleyball match frame with players and ball marked by detection boxes
featured.description: A YOLOv11 detector trained to find players and the ball in volleyball footage. It is the first step of a larger idea: track each player and map the action onto a top-down view of the court.
points: YOLOv11 fine-tuned on a public Roboflow dataset
Next: player tracking and court mapping

featured.title: Control of an autonomous e-bike on STM32
featured.imageAlt: A small blue bicycle on a lab bench fitted with control boards, motor drivers and a steering actuator
featured.description: Replaced the original Renesas microcontroller of a self-driving e-bike with an STM32H745 board, then re-integrated and tested the IMU, GPS and encoder along with the vehicle's actuators.
points: Firmware port to a dual-core STM32H7
Sensor and actuator bring-up on the vehicle

more.title: CNN inference on an STM32 board
more.description: Trained an image-recognition CNN in TensorFlow and deployed it on an STM32F429I-DISCO for real-time inference, validating accuracy on the device.

more.title: Heart attack risk: classification and clustering
more.description: Eight classifiers tuned with grid search, plus K-means, DBSCAN and hierarchical clustering with and without PCA, on a clinical dataset.

more.title: Temperature forecasting with SARIMAX
more.description: Seasonal time-series models on five years of hourly temperature data for US cities, with adjustable forecast horizons and confidence intervals.

more.title: Video game recommendation chatbot
more.description: A conversational assistant built with the Rasa framework that recommends video games, packaged with Docker Compose.

more.title: Game of Thrones network analysis
more.description: Social network analysis of character interactions: centrality measures, PageRank and Louvain community detection with interactive graphs.
